slots.label: Parts of a cell and their jobs
slots.labelAf: Dele van ’n sel en hul take

items.q: Which organelle controls the activities of the cell and contains DNA?
items.qAf: Watter organel beheer die aktiwiteite van die sel en bevat DNA?
items.explain: The nucleus controls cell activities and contains the genetic material (DNA).
items.explainAf: Die kern beheer selaktiwiteite en bevat die genetiese materiaal (DNA).

items.q: Where does aerobic respiration release most of the energy in a cell?
items.qAf: Waar stel aërobiese respirasie die meeste energie in ’n sel vry?
items.explain: Mitochondria are the site of aerobic respiration, which releases energy from glucose.
items.explainAf: Mitochondria is die plek van aërobiese respirasie, wat energie uit glukose vrystel.

items.q: A cell cannot control what enters and leaves it. Which part is damaged?
items.qAf: ŉ Sel kan nie beheer wat in- en uitgaan nie. Watter deel is beskadig?
items.explain: The cell membrane is selectively permeable and controls the movement of substances in and out of the cell.
items.explainAf: Die selmembraan is selektief deurlaatbaar en beheer die beweging van stowwe in en uit die sel.

items.q: Which structure is found in plant cells but NOT in animal cells?
items.qAf: Watter struktuur is in plantselle maar NIE in dierselle nie?
items.explain: Plant cells have a rigid cell wall made of cellulose, which animal cells do not have.
items.explainAf: Plantselle het ’n stywe selwand van sellulose, wat dierselle nie het nie.

items.explain: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll, which captures light energy for photosynthesis.
items.explainAf: Chloroplaste bevat chlorofil, wat ligenergie vir fotosintese vang.

items.q: A learner observes a cell under a microscope with no chloroplasts and a large central vacuole. Which cell is it most likely?
items.qAf: ’n Leerder sien ’n sel onder ’n mikroskoop sonder chloroplaste en met ’n groot sentrale vakuool. Watter sel is dit waarskynlik?
options: A cell from a green leaf
items.explain: Root cells have no chloroplasts because they are underground; a large vacuole stores water.
items.explainAf: Wortelselle het geen chloroplaste nie omdat hulle ondergronds is; ’n groot vakuool berg water.
